name: portfolio-dashboard
description: A CMS-style dashboard for managing my portfolio content
notes: ["The CMS-style dashboard where I edit the repos, their metadata and stats that portfolio-api serves.","React 19 with TypeScript and Vite, token-based login behind Google reCAPTCHA, tables for the records and Recharts for the stats."]

name: secondhand-api
notes: ["Backend for SecondHand, an e-commerce clone built as a team project (group 6) and mirrored here from GitLab.","Express with Sequelize migrations and seeders on PostgreSQL, deployed to Heroku with separate staging and production apps."]

name: news-portal
description: Simple CRUD News App built with Laravel and React

name: tes-kasir-alan
notes: ["A point-of-sale app built as the technical test for a Web Developer role at Alan Creative. Laravel on the back end, React on the front."]

name: following-vs-followers
description: "Who are you following that isn't following back? Who's following you that you haven't followed yet? Find out instantly."
notes: ["Compares who you follow on GitHub with who follows you back, in both directions.","Both lists are fetched in parallel to keep large accounts fast, up to a limit of 30,000 followers or following."]

name: user-game-api
description: Simple game api that store user account, biodata, and game histories
notes: ["Stores user accounts, biodata and game histories. Express on PostgreSQL, deployed to Heroku."]

name: bookmark-api
description: Simple Bookmark API built with NestJS and Prisma
notes: ["A bookmark service with two front doors: a REST API documented in Swagger and a GraphQL endpoint, both on NestJS with Prisma and PostgreSQL."]

name: portfolio
description: My portfolio website built with React
notes: ["This site. React and Vite, prerendered at build time so every page ships real HTML, with the project rows read from portfolio-api.","The design treats the work as a schema: a developer entity, project rows, and stacks joined to projects."]

name: portfolio-api
description: REST API powering my portfolio website
notes: ["The API behind this page. NestJS and Prisma on PostgreSQL (Neon), with JWT auth, a sync that pulls repos from GitHub, Cloudinary for the thumbnails and Swagger docs.","Every project row on this site, and every line in the schema above it, comes from its /repo endpoint."]

name: orm2erd
description: Generate ERD diagrams (Mermaid, DBML, PlantUML, D2, and more) straight from your ORM's models/schema.
notes: ["You already wrote the models, so the schema exists. orm2erd reads them and writes the ERD, instead of someone drawing and maintaining one by hand.","It detects the ORM (Prisma, Sequelize, Mongoose, TypeORM, Drizzle, MikroORM), resolves the entry points, normalizes everything into one intermediate model, then emits Mermaid, DBML, PlantUML, D2 and more from a single parse.","A --check flag fails CI when the committed diagram falls behind the models. Published on npm under the MIT license."]
